response.overview: Working at a secret SCP Foundation site is stressful enough...  Now imagine the one switch that powers the whole place won’t turn on.  Meet your average, slightly burned-out SCP technician. His job? Keep the lights on and the containment protocols running. But when The Switch fails, the countdown to disaster begins—and so does the awkward panic. What follows is a tension-filled (and slightly ridiculous) race against time to stop... well, probably the end of the world.
response.title: The Switch
